messages:
Alex (AE): Heads-up: CareBridge POC finished. They want to convert to a 12mo committed agreement. Legal flagged DPA liability cap + subprocessor clause. Procurement needs PO workflow and signer names. Can we fast-path this?

Sam (SE): Security requests SAML SSO + SOC2. BYOK/KMS not needed for POC, but they asked to note BYOK availability for Private deployments.

Jordan (Legal): DPA redline summary: (1) add subprocessor approval language, (2) 30-day data return/export, (3) cap = 1x fees. We can accept (1) as notice + objection window, and (2) is ok if we add security attestations. Cap at 1x fees needs legal lead/exec approval.

Priya (Procurement): PO checklist: legal entity name, tax ID, remit address, PO number, primary + backup signers, and preferred e-sign provider. They prefer DocuSign and customer to sign first. Who collects names?

Alex (AE): I'll collect. Tentative signers: Evelyn Park (CFO) + Marco Santos (Head Procurement). Billing entity: CareBridge Health, Inc. Tax ID: 12-3456789. Remit: 400 Wellness Way, Denver, CO 80202.

Nora (Finance): Net30 is fine. Need billing contact email + remittance instructions on order form. Also request PO number before invoicing; if not available, add "PO to follow" line so we can invoice.

ops-privacy-bot: SOC2 report linked: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-v3

Sam (SE): Suggest order form note: "BYOK available for Private deployments per separate SOW; not in scope for this POC." Keeps scope narrow.

Jordan (Legal): For signature sequencing: we prefer customer sign -> vendor countersign automatically. Add clause: "Electronic signatures (DocuSign) have same effect as originals."

Priya (Procurement): Procurement prefers customer signs first then Redwood countersigns. They will only issue PO after countersign in some cases; if so, add invoice language to handle PO lag.

Alex (AE): Draft order form snippet I'm putting in email to them:

```
Order Form
Customer: CareBridge Health, Inc.
Billing contact: ap@carebridge.com
Remit address: 400 Wellness Way, Denver, CO 80202
Term: 12 months
Commit: $55,000 / month
Billing terms: Net30
One-time onboarding credit: $5,000 applied to invoice #1 upon milestone completion
Signers: Evelyn Park (CFO), Marco Santos (Head Procurement)
```

Jordan (Legal): Add e-sign clause and include ops-privacy@redwood.com + legal lead if liability cap exception needed (cc emma_r). I'll upload the redlined DPA with comment threads.

Nora (Finance): Please cc finance-billing@redwood.com on the send. If they require PO-matching GL codes, ask them to provide mapping.

Alex (AE): Plan: send OF + DPA redline to CareBridge legal, collect signer confirmation, and request anticipated PO number. I'll loop back here with replies. :thumbsup:
